integrity: The primary continuity theorem, its deformation definition, its single bounded Kohn–Nirenberg model, and its geometric open question were inspected directly. The new family was checked by explicit Levi-form, weighted-flow, divisor-escape, and supporting-hypersurface calculations. Older hypersurface-Green and generalized Kohn–Nirenberg literature was compared for implication scope. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The sufficient parameter range \(1<\beta<m^2/(2m-1)\) is not claimed optimal. The sector angle is obtained existentially from uniform first-order inwardness and compactness. The conclusion is proved for the natural reduced divisor family \((w-1)^2-\lambda z^2=0\), not for all hypersurface poles.
title: An infinite Kohn–Nirenberg tower with continuous hypersurface Green functions
